_comment: The art pipeline's contract with the game: which GLB stem a faction fields for a role at an epoch. Keyed by the GAME's role names, because the stems' own shortnames (btr60, 2s3, sovremenny) cannot be derived from a role and the previous heuristic could therefore only ever find MBTs. Written by tools/, read by SimFactionData. MBT rows point at the NATIONAL models rather than the plain mbt_e4_<code> stems: those are 41 KB untextured blockouts, and the resolver's 'an exact stem beats a variant-suffixed one' rule made them win over the finished 3 MB models sitting beside them. Every tank in the game was a white box.
